description: Debt Payoff Calculator - Calculate payoff timeline using Avalanche (highest interest first) vs Snowball (smallest balance first) methods with month-by-month projection.
steps: Create lib/services/debt_calculator.dart with calculateAvalanche(List<Debt> debts, double monthlyPayment) method that: (1) sorts debts by interest rate descending, (2) applies minimum payments to all debts, (3) applies remaining monthly payment to highest interest debt first, (4) generates month-by-month projection showing which debts are paid off when and total interest paid

Add calculateSnowball(List<Debt> debts, double monthlyPayment) method that uses same logic but sorts debts by remaining balance ascending (smallest first), prioritizing psychological wins of clearing small debts quickly
Both methods return projection object with: totalMonths, totalInterestPaid, monthByMonthBreakdown (array of {month, remainingBalances, paymentAllocations}), debtFreeDate

Create lib/screens/debt_payoff_screen.dart with: (1) input section showing list of current debts from DBService with balance and interest rate, (2) monthly payment amount slider, (3) method selector (Avalanche/Snowball radio buttons with explanations), (4) Calculate button that generates comparison

Add results section showing side-by-side comparison: Avalanche vs Snowball with cards displaying total months, total interest paid, debt-free date, and savings difference. Highlight which method saves more money (usually Avalanche) vs which provides faster psychological wins (Snowball).
Add month-by-month breakdown table or chart showing payment allocation and remaining balances over time. Use fl_chart BarChart or LineChart to visualize decreasing debt balances.

Add debt interest rate management: enhance debt_screen.dart to add optional interest_rate field to debts table (ALTER TABLE debts ADD COLUMN interest_rate REAL DEFAULT 0). Update debt form to include interest rate input (annual %) with info explaining why this matters for payoff strategy.
Add navigation link to debt_payoff_screen from debt_screen.dart (add button in app bar) and from home_screen.dart drawer under 'Tools' section
acceptance_criteria: Debt payoff calculator shows comparison of Avalanche vs Snowball methods
Avalanche method correctly prioritizes highest interest rate debts
Snowball method correctly prioritizes smallest balance debts
Results show total months, total interest paid, and debt-free date for both methods
Month-by-month projection visualizes how debts decrease over time
Calculator handles edge cases (monthly payment less than minimum payments, single debt, zero interest debts)
verification: Test scenario 1: 3 debts (₱10k at 18%, ₱5k at 12%, ₱8k at 15%), monthly payment ₱3k → Avalanche pays 18% debt first, Snowball pays ₱5k debt first
Test scenario 2: Results show Avalanche pays off in 9 months with ₱2,100 interest, Snowball pays off in 10 months with ₱2,300 interest → Avalanche saves ₱200
Test scenario 3: Monthly payment of ₱1k (less than sum of minimums) → shows warning 'Monthly payment must be at least ₱X to cover minimum payments'
Test scenario 4: Chart visualizes 3 lines (one per debt) decreasing to zero over time
Test scenario 5: Single debt → both methods show identical results
